claims.head: Anaheim pounces on mistakes, and Edmonton makes them
claims.body: Anaheim ranks 3rd of 32 for chances off turnovers (7.7% of its chances come right after winning the puck); Edmonton ranks 29th for avoiding breakdowns.

claims.head: Quality over quantity for Edmonton
claims.body: Anaheim has struggled to keep shots to the perimeter (26th of 32), and Edmonton makes its shots count: one expected goal for every 15.3 unblocked shots, 10th in the league.

notes.text: M. Savoie has not played this season. L. Draisaitl is in his usual spot beside C. McDavid and V. Podkolzin. That line is getting 13:10 a game at 5-on-5, up from 9:11 with Savoie.
J. Dickinson has not played this season. L. Draisaitl is in his usual spot beside K. Kapanen and V. Podkolzin. That line is getting 6:32 a game at 5-on-5, up from 2:15 with Dickinson.
K. Kapanen has started playing on the power play: on the ice for 51% of the team’s power-play time in 3 games, up from 6% last season.

ANA.head: Too close to call
ANA.body: Edmonton has had more of the chances over recent games and Anaheim has home ice. For Anaheim, the difference could be pouncing on loose pucks.

EDM.head: Too close to call
EDM.body: Edmonton has had more of the chances over recent games and Anaheim has home ice. Edmonton can tip it if it gets to the dangerous areas.
